name: RDB40
subtitle: Industrial - Gateway
description: A ceiling-mounted indoor access point on MediaTek MT7628 with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, integrated BLE 6.0 with long-range FEM, and 802.3af PoE IN. Designed for indoor asset tracking, smart building sensor aggregation, and single-cable Wi-Fi access point deployment.

physical.value: 190 x 190 x 40 mm (W x D x H)

use_cases.title: Indoor Asset Tracking & Real-Time Location Services (RTLS)
use_cases.desc: Enables real-time tracking of people, equipment, and movable assets within indoor environments using connected positioning technologies. It provides location visibility, movement insights, and asset utilization data to improve operational efficiency and simplify asset management.

use_cases.title: Smart Building Sensor Data Aggregation
use_cases.desc: Collects data from distributed building sensors, including temperature, humidity, occupancy, and environmental monitoring devices, through a unified network. This enables centralized data visibility and supports intelligent building automation, energy optimization, and better facility management.

use_cases.title: Single-Cable PoE Indoor Wi-Fi Access Point Deployment
use_cases.desc: Simplifies indoor Wi-Fi deployment by delivering both network connectivity and electrical power to access points through a single Ethernet cable. This reduces cabling requirements, installation complexity, and infrastructure costs while providing reliable wireless coverage.
